Use try / except / else / finally together.

Supplied answer
try:
    num = int(input("Enter a number: "))
except ValueError:
    print("Invalid input")
else:
    print("No error, the number is", num) # runs only if no error
finally:
    print("This always runs") # cleanup code
Note: else runs when there was no exception; finally always runs, error or not.
